title: Morning You Is Taller Than Evening You
hook: You'll measure tallest if you do it in the morning
summary: People are tallest in the morning and a little shorter by the afternoon. In space, they get about 2.5 cm taller.

text: Your height in the morning and your height in the evening aren't the same.

panels.text: Come on, your height changes in a single day?

text: One study measured the height of 100 children.
Compared to when they woke up,
they were about 1.5 cm shorter on average between 4 and 5 PM.

panels.mean: average height lost from morning to afternoon

text: Standing and sitting under gravity all day
squishes your body down just a tiny bit.
So what about space, where there's almost no gravity?
Within a month, the skeleton stretches out,
and you get about 2.5 cm taller.

panels.text: If I wanna be taller, I'm going to space

sources: Wikipedia: Effect of spaceflight on the human body
